findings.finding: Claim under doubt: The fix repairs the Windows cold-start case, where win32 relies on execFile honouring options.env.PATH — the behavior the code calls unreliable on POSIX — with no end-to-end test. — The asymmetry is real and correct: POSIX execvp resolves against the PARENT environ (so we resolve absolutely via resolvePosixBin), while libuv win32 search_path reads PATH from the CHILD env block. Verified empirically: a copied node.exe placed only in a temp dir, with the process PATH excluding it, is found via options.env.PATH.

Claim under doubt: PATH-augmentation is the actual root cause of the 3.9.6-instead-of-3.11 symptom, vs uv-find returning non-zero. — System python3 is 3.9.6 on the shared machine; had it been 3.11+ sysPyOk would report it directly. Preflight (identical find-logic) reported 3.11, which can ONLY have come from the uv-managed fallback (uv python find), proving a uv-managed 3.11 is installed — so once the server resolves uv, uv python find >=3.11 returns 0. The two surfaces share the exact fallback gate.
